data.signal: Situationist derive / urban drifting. LATENT INTERPRETATION: beneath the theory is a PRACTICE with physical shape: long unplanned walks through cities (hours, variable weather), deliberate refusal of phone navigation and algorithmic mediation, heightened observation, and a strong documentation impulse — practitioners record impressions (notes, sketches, film photos, voice) WITHOUT interrupting the drift. The tension: documentation and carry needs vs. the drift's demand for unencumbered, unmediated movement. Living communities: psychogeography groups, flaneur/urban-walking culture, urbex, film-photography walkers, 'analog walk' practitioners, one-bag/EDC walkers. This joins King's validated 'analog backlash / friction objects' vertical: people deliberately choosing physical tools against algorithmic mediation.

polymath_evidence.summary: Debord: derive = technique of rapid passage through varied ambiances; drop usual motives for movement; let attractions of the terrain direct you
Psychogeography practice traditions: walkers document ambiances via notes, sketches, photographs; the record is part of the practice
King's validated vertical: anti-algorithm 'friction objects' — typewriters, film cameras, paper notebooks — chosen deliberately against AI mediation; buying-intent patterns previously observed

behaviors: documenting impressions mid-walk without stopping the drift
adaptations: carrying pocket notebooks and film cameras instead of using the phone

challenges.argument: Sling/chest carry is a crowded photo-accessory space; delta must come from ANALOG-specific quick-draw (notebook+film) not another camera bag. Keep, demand delta evidence.
Standing notation friction is real in field professions (registry: field_recording seeds) but consumer demand unproven. Keep — high info gain.
Corpus precedent: retractable tether appears in engineering sources; badge-reel repurposing is cheap to check. Keep — fast falsification.
Ritual-kit is identity merchandise until proven otherwise; strongest alternative explanation (self-curation). Wildcard retained for info gain.
Workaround-to-product proven: an artist manufactured her own walking-sketcher bag (Walkit), self-assembled kit bags documented across 3 community sources, friction evidenced. SUPPORTED.

Field evidence PROMOTES the analogy: LOCHBY sells exactly this kit; Etsy category exists; buying guides active. Self-curation remains the competing delta angle (kit must beat self-assembly on curation quality). SUPPORTED with that caveat recorded.
Standing-support friction evidenced (clipboards) but one-hand instrument demand unproven this round. HOLD — unproven, not disproven.
